rows.result: Ancient — Ancestral structures that have stood the test of time
Dismal — Gloomy, tightly-packed structures and shadowed paths
Foreboding — Structures with ornate, dramatic forms and cavernous interiors
Fortified — Imposing structures hardened against assaults
Garish — Structures with tacky design and showy adornments
Grand — Majestic structures with opulent details
Idyllic — Organic forms and materials, at one with the landscape
Industrial — Grim, utilitarian structures, built for function over form
Makeshift — Temporary shelters for nomadic or displaced people
Ramshackle — Haphazard structures using scavenged or repurposed materials
Wondrous — Enigmatic structures of awe-inspiring design or function
